change: Scope Doctor's Codex recovery instructions to the current agent

review.reviewer: Implementation owner (Codex self-review after independent finding)
review.decision: Use the current pane's Codex identity for terminal recovery instructions
review.notes: A historical index can survive a different agent starting in the same pane. Preserve the diagnostic result and avoid Codex focus or resume instructions for that pane. A genuinely current Codex with a separate missing record can still get its own guidance.

cases.description: Doctor withholds Codex actions when a different current agent occupies a previously bound location
cases.setup: Synthetic prior Codex proof at a location whose current agent is Claude Code. A separate variant adds a current Codex pane with no record.
cases.action: Inspect Doctor's binding row in both cases.
cases.expected: The historical failure remains readable. Focus and managed resume guidance never applies to the active Claude terminal. A current Codex pane in a mixed report gets only its own focus command along with draft and launch-context guidance.
